title: A2A Extensions and Updates
summary: This module provides mechanisms for extending Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication with custom functionalities like A2UI, and handles various update strategies such as polling, streaming, and push notifications.

nodes.label: A2UI Client Extension
nodes.title: A2UI Client Extension
nodes.description: Injects A2UI prompt instructions, tracks UI state, and validates A2UI messages in agent responses for client-side A2A interactions.

nodes.label: A2UI Server Extension
nodes.title: A2UI Server Extension
nodes.description: Enables A2UI declarative UI generation on the server side, negotiating catalog preferences and wrapping A2UI messages as A2A DataParts.

nodes.label: Validate A2UI Event
nodes.title: Validate A2UI Event
nodes.description: Parses and validates A2UI client-to-server events against defined schemas for both v0.8 and v0.9 of the protocol.

nodes.label: Get Extensions From Config
nodes.title: Get Extensions From Config
nodes.description: Extracts and deduplicates extension URIs from A2A client configurations to identify active extensions.

nodes.label: Polling Update Handler
nodes.title: Polling Update Handler
nodes.description: Manages A2A delegation updates using a polling mechanism, repeatedly checking the task status until completion or timeout.

nodes.label: Streaming Update Handler
nodes.title: Streaming Update Handler
nodes.description: Handles A2A delegation updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, processing real-time task status and artifact updates.

nodes.label: Push Notification Handler
nodes.title: Push Notification Handler
nodes.description: Processes A2A delegation updates using push notifications (webhooks), waiting for external callbacks to signal task completion.

nodes.label: A2A Core
nodes.title: A2A Core Module
nodes.description: The central module for Agent-to-Agent communication, handling configuration, message wrapping, and delegation utilities.

nodes.label: Event System
nodes.title: Event System Module
nodes.description: Manages the event bus and defines various event types for tracking A2A interactions and system state changes.

groups.label: A2UI Extensions
groups.title: A2UI Extensions
groups.description: Components responsible for integrating A2UI (Agent-to-Agent User Interface) capabilities into the A2A communication flow, handling both client and server aspects.

groups.label: Update Handlers
groups.title: Update Handlers
groups.description: Different strategies for managing and receiving updates during A2A task execution, including polling, streaming, and push notifications.

groups.label: Configuration and Registry
groups.title: Configuration and Registry
groups.description: Manages the registration and retrieval of A2A extensions based on configuration settings.
